entries.original_title: Perplexity API changelog updated
entries.subtitle: The October 2026 Perplexity API changelog adds Agent API effort-level updates, including an ultra-preview level, and says earlier pinned versions remain available.
entries.reject_reason: The changelog adds an API effort level and configuration updates, not a new model or major product launch.

entries.original_title: Le Chonk: Built for Coders, Trusted by Defenders.
entries.subtitle: Mistral released the weights of its improved 1-trillion-parameter multimodal model, with gains in coding, defensive cybersecurity, and reasoning efficiency.
entries.reject_reason: Mistral is releasing improved weights for the previously launched Large 4, not a new named model or version.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Intrinsic Distribution Matching
entries.subtitle: Intrinsic Distribution Matching adds explicit moment constraints to improve few-step text-to-image generation and long-text rendering with minimal network evaluations.
entries.reject_reason: The paper is from untracked inclusionAI; using Qwen in experiments does not make it Qwen research.

entries.original_title: Paper page - WorkFactory: Turning Professional Intents into Executable Work for Scalable Agent Training
entries.subtitle: WorkFactory creates professional tasks from work intents, using 112,686 tasks across 612 occupations to train the WorkPilot model family.
entries.reject_reason: WorkFactory is research from an untracked team that fine-tunes Qwen models, not research from Qwen.

entries.original_title: Microsoft Research Focus – Edition #97
entries.subtitle: Microsoft Research Focus highlights work on coding agents, AI use at work, and extended-range weather forecasting.
entries.reject_reason: This newsletter recaps several Microsoft research items rather than reporting a distinct new result.

entries.original_title: Paper page - VibeGame: Prompt-to-Game Development with AI-Native Engine and Self-Evolving Adversarial Agent Team
entries.subtitle: VibeGame uses an AI-native engine and specialized agents to build complete 2D games from natural-language prompts and test their behavior interactively.
entries.reject_reason: VibeGame is research from untracked university authors; evaluating it with OpenAI models does not make it OpenAI research.

entries.original_title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
entries.subtitle: OpenAI’s updated spec sets five core values to guide capable AI toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.
entries.reject_reason: The Model Spec update describes guiding values but does not establish a material policy change or announce research, a product feature, or a model.

entries.original_title: Amiraigc: Kling 4.0 Brings Subtle Emotions to Life!
entries.subtitle: Creator @amiraigc tests Kling 4.0 in a friendship story, using native 30s generation, Omni Reference for 12 characters, and multiple keyframes.
entries.reject_reason: The creator's film showcases the already available Kling 4.0 rather than announcing its launch.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Your Benchmark Is an Empirical Measure Over Difficulty
entries.subtitle: A study of 25 benchmarks across 7 domains finds that many overemphasize some difficulty levels, so their leaderboard results need careful interpretation.
entries.reject_reason: This benchmark paper is from untracked university researchers, with a tracker merely hosting its page.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Look Only When Needed: Certificate-Guided Visual Routing for Efficient Diffusion VLMs
entries.subtitle: LOWN skips image processing during diffusion vision-language model decoding when predictions agree, reducing computation while preserving accuracy.
entries.reject_reason: This diffusion-VLM paper is from untracked KAIST researchers rather than a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - L3G-World: Real-Time Infinite World Generation with Latent 3D Gaussian Memory
entries.subtitle: L3G-World uses compact latent 3D Gaussian memory and a video diffusion transformer to generate spatially consistent interactive worlds in real time.
entries.reject_reason: The interactive-world research is from untracked KAIST researchers, not a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Announcing Project ProtoStar: Making Publicly Funded Science AI-Ready
entries.subtitle: Project ProtoStar aims to make publicly funded research easier to reuse, and its first challenge, hosted by Carnegie Mellon University, opens on November 2.
entries.reject_reason: Hugging Face is a partner in Project ProtoStar, but the announcement is an initiative rather than a research result, model release, or product launch.

entries.original_title: Granite Switch 4.1.1 — Update models like you update software
entries.subtitle: Granite Switch 4.1.1 is a backwards-compatible patch with no migration, an updated speech-to-text model for 10 languages, and an updated Decision adapter.
entries.reject_reason: This third-party Granite Switch patch updates an existing model and adapters rather than launching a new model from Hugging Face.

entries.original_title: Security notice — malicious version of Anthropic.claude-code (2.1.313) identified in the Cursor Extension Marketplace · Cursor
entries.subtitle: A malicious Anthropic.claude-code version 2.1.313 in the Cursor Marketplace tried to collect system data and install an SSH backdoor, affecting at most 5,000 users.
entries.reject_reason: The Cursor extension security incident is significant but does not match research, product launches, or model releases.

entries.original_title: Clairic - API Pricing & Providers
entries.subtitle: Cloudflare’s Clairic model extracts, computes, estimates, and forecasts typed values from text and optional images, with a confidence score and null probability for each field.
entries.reject_reason: Clairic is a model from untracked Cloudflare, not from the tracked model-listing site.

entries.original_title: Paper page - HairDeck: Animation-Ready Stylized Hair Cards from a Single Image
entries.subtitle: HairDeck creates stylized hair cards and spring-bone animations from one image, with 44% lower Chamfer distance, more than half the card-orientation error, and 33 times faster processing.
entries.reject_reason: HairDeck is research from untracked university authors, merely listed on a tracked paper site.

entries.original_title: Introducing AnySpeechRecognizer and AnyDecisionModel: Open Models for Speech and Decisions on Apple Platforms
entries.subtitle: AnySpeechRecognizer and AnyDecisionModel add Swift APIs for speech recognition and typed decisions, including local NVIDIA’s Parakeet and Alibaba’s Qwen3-ASR models on Core ML.
entries.reject_reason: The announced Swift packages are third-party developer libraries that use the Hugging Face Hub, not a tracked entity’s model or product launch.

entries.original_title: L’avenir appartient à tous: Meta et INCA s’associent pour soutenir les personnes aveugles, sourdes et aveugles ou ayant une basse vision au Canada
entries.subtitle: Meta and INCA will work with blind, deafblind, and low-vision people in Canada to explore AI glasses and help shape accessible products.
entries.reject_reason: Meta's accessibility partnership supports use of existing AI glasses but does not launch a product or report a research result.

entries.original_title: Who Gets to Build the Frontier for AI | Cohere
entries.subtitle: Cohere announced the initial close of a Series E funding round targeting up to CAD $7 Billion to build a frontier AI company outside the U.S. and China.
entries.reject_reason: Cohere's funding announcement and strategic ambitions are not research results or launches.

entries.original_title: SK hynix Hosts First Partners Day in Japan, Sharing Business Direction with Key Local Partners
entries.subtitle: SK hynix held its first Japan Partners Day with executives from over 20 local partners to share business direction as AI drives memory demand.
entries.reject_reason: This supplier meeting and business-direction update contains no concrete AI research or launch.

entries.original_title: Mischief 1 - API Pricing & Providers
entries.subtitle: Mischief 1 is a neuron-derived video model that supports image-to-video generation and costs from $0.005 /second.
entries.reject_reason: Mischief 1 is a model from an untracked company, merely listed by a tracker.

entries.original_title: AWS Marketplace now enables partners to list once and sell through multiple subsidiary accounts
entries.subtitle: AWS Marketplace partners can publish one listing for subsidiaries to sell through private offers and view offers, agreements, and renewals in one place.
entries.reject_reason: The AWS Marketplace subsidiary-listing feature is a commerce administration update, not an AI-focused launch.

entries.original_title: Riverflow V2.6 Pro - API Pricing & Benchmarks
entries.subtitle: Riverflow V2.6 Pro supports text-to-image and image editing, accepts up to 10 input images, and offers custom dimensions up to 16,384 px per edge.
entries.reject_reason: Riverflow 2.6 Pro is from untracked Sourceful and is only listed by a tracked model site.

entries.original_title: Amazon Aurora now supports post-quantum TLS key exchange
entries.subtitle: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL adds post-quantum TLS key exchange, and versions 18 and higher let users change the ssl_groups parameter.
entries.reject_reason: Post-quantum TLS support is a database security update rather than AI research or a relevant launch.

entries.original_title: Joey 1 - API Pricing & Providers
entries.subtitle: Joey 1 is a 2B decision model that returns calibrated probabilities in one pass for routing, classification, and guardrail checks.
entries.reject_reason: Joey 1 is a Baseten model rather than a release from the tracked listing site.

entries.original_title: Amazon RDS for Oracle and SQL Server now support storage autoscaling on additional storage volumes
entries.subtitle: Amazon RDS for SQL Server and Oracle can now autoscale additional storage volumes, which can total up to 256 TiB across up to three added volumes.
entries.reject_reason: Additional-volume autoscaling is a routine database feature unrelated to the AI interests.

entries.original_title: How Ropes & Gray is developing AI for transactional diligence
entries.subtitle: Ropes & Gray is developing AI for transactional diligence with OpenAI, while lawyers review grouped documents, summaries, and reports before advising clients.
entries.reject_reason: This is a customer-use story, not new research, a launch, or a product update.

entries.original_title: When is Black Friday 2026? Here’s everything you need to know
entries.subtitle: Black Friday falls on November 27, 2026, and Amazon suggests using its Holiday Shop and Alexa for Shopping to track prices and set deal alerts.
entries.reject_reason: This Black Friday guide mentions existing Alexa shopping features without announcing one.

entries.original_title: Amazon MSK Connect now supports updating connector plugins and worker configurations
entries.subtitle: Amazon MSK Connect users can update connector plugins and worker settings in place, while keeping committed offsets and avoiding connector recreation.
entries.reject_reason: In-place Kafka connector configuration updates do not match the AI-focused interests.

entries.original_title: Amazon Managed Grafana now supports in-place upgrade to Grafana version 13.2
entries.subtitle: Amazon Managed Grafana supports an in-place upgrade from version 12.4 to 13.2, adding Git Sync, dynamic dashboards, and PromQL queries.
entries.reject_reason: This managed Grafana version upgrade is not an AI product or research development.

entries.original_title: Training Videos: Types, Tips, and How to Create Them
entries.subtitle: The guide covers training video formats, examples, and a four-step workflow for creating videos with Kling AI.
entries.reject_reason: This is a guide to making training videos with existing Kling tools, not a launch.

entries.original_title: What Is an Animatic and How Do You Make One?
entries.subtitle: The guide shows how an animatic can test pacing, character movement, and camera direction before production, with Kling AI to refine a draft.
entries.reject_reason: This animatic tutorial describes an existing workflow rather than new Kling research or a launch.

entries.original_title: Shot List: How to Plan Every Shot Before Filming
entries.subtitle: The guide explains what to include in a shot list and offers a template, an example, and ways to preview shots with Kling AI.
entries.reject_reason: This shot-list guide does not announce a new Kling feature or model.

entries.original_title: Video Marketing Guide: How to Plan, Create, and Grow With AI
entries.subtitle: The guide covers video planning, sharing, and performance, and shows how Kling AI can turn ideas and existing assets into footage.
entries.reject_reason: This marketing guide promotes existing Kling capabilities without a new development.

entries.original_title: AWS DataSync Enhanced mode now supports Amazon FSx for Windows File Server, FSx for NetApp ONTAP, and Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization
entries.subtitle: DataSync Enhanced mode now supports FSx for Windows and FSx for NetApp ONTAP locations, plus agents on Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization version 4.20 or later.
entries.reject_reason: Additional DataSync transfer and deployment options do not match the AI interests.

entries.original_title: Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) is now available in additional Regions
entries.subtitle: DAX is now available in Canada (Central) and Africa (Cape Town), where its managed cache can speed up DynamoDB reads by up to ten times.
entries.reject_reason: DAX expansion to two regions is a minor availability update unrelated to AI.

entries.original_title: AWS Backup now supports cross-account management and cross-account backup in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud
entries.subtitle: AWS Backup adds cross-account management, backups, and delegated administrators in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany) Region for centralized control and added backup protection.
entries.reject_reason: Existing backup capabilities expanding to another AWS region do not match the AI interests.

entries.original_title: ACM now supports ACME for public certificates in AWS GovCloud (US)
entries.subtitle: ACM now supports ACME public certificates in AWS GovCloud (US-East) and AWS GovCloud (US-West), enabling automated certificate issuance and renewal.
entries.reject_reason: ACME support expanding to GovCloud is a routine regional security-service update.

entries.original_title: Public endpoints for Amazon ElastiCache Serverless now in AWS GovCloud (US)
entries.subtitle: ElastiCache Serverless for Valkey adds public endpoints in AWS GovCloud (US), allowing external connections with IAM authentication over TLS 1.3.
entries.reject_reason: Regional availability of ElastiCache public endpoints is unrelated to AI developments.

entries.original_title: Slice Into GFN Thursday: ‘Phantom Blade Zero’ Launches on GeForce NOW
entries.subtitle: GeForce NOW adds Phantom Blade Zero and nine other games, new mod support, and four-month memberships in India, while World of Warcraft: Forever arrives Wednesday, Nov. 4 at 3 p.m. PST.
entries.reject_reason: GeForce NOW game availability is unrelated to the specified AI research and launches.

entries.original_title: The official ‘James Bond’ films in order: How to watch 007 on Prime Video
entries.subtitle: All 25 official James Bond films stream on Prime Video, from Dr. No (1962) to No Time to Die (2021), and Denis Villeneuve will direct the next film.
entries.reject_reason: A guide to streaming James Bond films does not match the AI interests.

entries.original_title: Building Rivendell: How 'The Rings of Power' team brought the iconic 'Lord of the Rings' location to life
entries.subtitle: The Rings of Power Season 3 introduces Rivendell, whose set uses a Tolkien watercolor as a guide and real plants and wood to reflect Elven nature.
entries.reject_reason: This television-production feature is unrelated to AI research, models, or product launches.
